title: Order nitrogen molecular ions
statement:
Order N2+, N2 and N2− from lowest to highest bond order. For equal bond orders, list the positive ion first.

[________]{a}
hints: N₂⁺ loses a bonding electron and N₂⁻ gains an antibonding electron.
The ions tie and neutral N₂ has the highest order.
solution: Neutral N₂ has order 3. Removing a bonding electron produces N₂⁺ with order 2.5. Adding to π* produces N₂⁻ with order 2.5. Apply the stated tie-breaker.
